header_970x600.label: Header Image
header_970x600.notes: Standard Image Header with Text module. Bottom 20% is the mobile safe zone — keep text and faces out of it.

banner_970x300.label: Banner
banner_970x300.notes: Wide lifestyle banner. Very little vertical room — avoid stacked text.

card_300x300.label: Feature Card
card_300x300.notes: Four-card or three-card module tile. Single focal subject reads best at this size.

comparison_150x150.label: Comparison Chart Cell
comparison_150x150.notes: Product thumbnail inside a comparison chart. Must be legible when tiny — no text.

grid_135x135.label: Image Grid Tile
grid_135x135.notes: Four-image grid tile. Smallest module — icon-like subjects only.
